title: The Cages
pages:
There is a cobblestone room with an iron cage in the middle of it.

Something turns inside the cage. Fire, or the shape of fire.

He found one on his first night underground. He stood in the doorway and did not go in.

The room has been waiting for him to go in ever since.

I broke the cages one at a time.

They did not stop. They only got louder, and then they got quiet.

That is how you leave a place like this. You do not win. You stop it making more.
